```{r, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  results='asis', 
  echo = FALSE
)

library(magrittr) # For the pipe
source("cv_printing_functions.r")

# Read in all data and initialize a CV printer object
CV <- create_CV_object(
  data_location = "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_Y3HPpenl9Q0rovGZUmto6kxSCrtv8BsTGSfdk-xdXk/edit?usp=sharing",  
  pdf_mode = params$pdf_mode
)

CV$entries_data <- CV$entries_data %>% dplyr::filter(in_resume == TRUE)

# Confirmed end date; keep the remaining spreadsheet entries unchanged.
aesculape_role <- CV$entries_data$title == "Clinical Research Associate II" &
  CV$entries_data$institution == "Aesculape Belgium-Singapore CRO"
CV$entries_data$end[aesculape_role] <- "Oct 2024"
CV$entries_data$end_year[aesculape_role] <- "2024"
CV$entries_data$no_end[aesculape_role] <- "FALSE"
CV$entries_data$has_end[aesculape_role] <- "TRUE"
CV$entries_data$timeline[aesculape_role] <- paste(
  "Oct 2024 -", CV$entries_data$start[aesculape_role]
)

```

Main
================================================================================

Dr Johan Ibrahim {#title}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

I am Dr Johan Ibrahim, Clinic Manager at Klinik Inocare on Jalan Pahang, Kuala Lumpur. My work brings together medical training, clinical research experience and operational leadership to strengthen clinic services and support patient care.


My experience spans clinical practice, clinical trial monitoring and health research, supported by a strong foundation in research design, medical statistics, data management and visualisation. With Good Clinical Practice certification, I am committed to ethical research, data quality and patient safety. I combine analytical thinking with a collaborative approach to solve problems, improve workflows and deliver results in demanding healthcare settings.

Work Experience {data-icon=suitcase}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Clinic Manager

Klinik Inocare

N/A

Present - Apr 2025

- Lead the rebuilding of clinic operations following a management takeover, establishing a revised approach to wound care and regenerative therapy services.
- Establish operating procedures, patient workflows, documentation practices and follow-up processes.
- Manage staffing, supplier coordination, financial administration and the operational requirements of patient services.
- Work with the clinic management software developer to translate operational needs into requirements for patient records, appointments, billing and inventory management.
- Provide ongoing feedback to refine the software already in use and specify requirements for automated patient follow-up.
- Define patient-data capture and export requirements with the developer to support planned exports of CDISC Analysis Data Model (ADaM) datasets for study analysis.
- Coordinate the collection and completeness of data required for an ongoing study evaluating the safety of stem cell therapy in patients with knee osteoarthritis.

Research Experience {data-icon=laptop `r if (params$pdf_mode) ".page-break-before" else ""`}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
::: aside
I'm a medical doctor by training. In the past, I've served people in Indonesia and Malaysia and actively involve in search and rescue during Earthquake in Indonesia, 2006. Then, I decided to have a change in direction and started working as Clinical Research Associate. In this role, I have the opportunity to help people by ensuring that clinical trials are conducted ethically and safely.

I'm an active participant in the local R community [Malaysia R User Group](https://www.meetup.com/MY-RUserGroup/). I'm also one of the moderator in [Analisa Data Dengan R Studio group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/analisaR/).

:::
